speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Mutton, and the heel of a loaf. Sit where I can see who is not eating.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: He is at war with his bread already, and the dinner is hardly down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The heel will do. I am not particular, until I am.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Eat, Will. Thou art Egeon at two, and a wreck wants a man who has dined.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: He has put the bread down. That was not a choice. That was a stop.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the crust.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Where does it pain you today, Will?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: For once, where I say. Here.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The left side, below. Today you point, which is more than you usually do.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On the left side, below. It answered the bread like a struck bell, and it is still answering.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: We are gracious. We will make a royal progress of it, to the barber, and the tooth may have a trumpet if it likes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou wilt not. I am Egeon at two. I am not going to a barber between a crust and a wreck.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then suffer in state. A king would, and look noble doing it.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: I buried two husbands. I had a remedy from each, and neither of them thanked me while he could.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not a third. Say the remedies.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: A clove, held on it. Or a hot knitting-needle, which is quicker, and which I do not love.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The clove.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: The clove, then. I will not heat the needle unless you ask with a whole mouth.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: He will not ask. He pointed. For him that is a speech.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Hold it where thou showed me. Left. Below. And eat the mutton on the other side.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Here. And leave the trumpet out of the yard.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: I can spare you a clove from the kitchen. Hold it on the place, and do not chew it across.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will. And I will have another for the night, and I will write the line when I am home.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Another for the night is a plan. The barber was a progress. I know which one you mean to keep.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art fit to walk. Do not make a progress of the walk. Make a progress of the part.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The part is a shipwreck. I will tell it out of whatever side of my mouth still answers.

speaker: agnes_tipping
text: Then go. If you change your mind about the needle, change it where I can see the iron.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not change it. Egeon can speak at two. The tooth can keep quiet in the tiring-house.
